Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?

Here's a quick comparison of the two everyday options:

The Everyday Backpack in Wave Blue ($65) holds 18L, fits up to a 13" laptop, has airmesh-backed straps for comfort, and includes a trolley sleeve to attach to your suitcase. It packs into its own zipper pocket, so you can stash it when not in use. 

The Everyday Crossbody in Jet Black ($45) is a compact 2.5L bag with an adjustable crossbody strap and a front zipper pocket. It's lighter at 0.3 lbs and great for quick outings where you just need the essentials. 

If you carry a laptop or want one bag that handles commutes and day trips, the backpack is the better fit. If you prefer something minimal for keys, phone, and a few small items, the crossbody is the way to go.
